name: APL Launcher
description: Apple-TV-style home screen: Top Shelf, glass dock, Control Center, Settings and Sources. Needs Vetro on a rooted screen: set Home to APL Launcher in Vetro's Remapper after install. Optional TMDB, YouTube and Fanart.tv keys are written into the package on install.

fields.label: TMDB API key (v3), for the live Top Shelf; optional
YouTube Data API v3 key, for TizenTube's Top Shelf; optional
Fanart.tv API key, for textless HD backgrounds; optional
